description: This PHP file acts as an AJAX handler for updating and retrieving network management settings, such as bridge mode and IGMP snooping, on a device. It processes POST requests, modifies configuration parameters via 'setStr' calls, and returns JSON responses.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within an array.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets a configuration parameter key to a specified value.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration parameter key.
